extension.description: Open installed OMP, Claude Code, and Codex in project terminals, or enter the AIO workbench.
command.openTerminal: Select an AI CLI and Open a Terminal
config.ompPath: Absolute path to the OMP executable. Leave empty to detect it automatically.

config.codexPath: Absolute path to the Codex executable. Leave empty to detect it automatically.
